overview: Build plan for a minifigure-scale Jedi in white robes holding 1 blue lightsaber. Break into 5 sub-assemblies: legs, torso/arms, head, hair, and lightsaber.

subassemblies.name: Legs + hips (white pants/boots)
subassemblies.description: Bottom of the figure (lower half). Build 2 legs (left and right) and 1 hip/pelvis block. Suggested micro-build: 2 feet blocks + 2 shin blocks + 1 shared hip connector.
subassemblies.imageRegion: Lower half of image, from belt down to feet (bottom center).

subassemblies.name: Torso + belt + arms (white robe top)
subassemblies.description: Center of the figure. Build 1 torso block, 2 arms (left and right), and 2 hands (left and right). Add 1 belt band around the waist (suggested as a thin plate layer).
subassemblies.imageRegion: Middle of image, between legs and head (center).

subassemblies.name: Head (face)
subassemblies.description: Top center. Build 1 head block (a small cube/rounded cube) with 1 front 'face tile/plate' to suggest eyes/mouth area.
subassemblies.imageRegion: Upper center, just above the torso (face area).

subassemblies.name: Hair (blond, swept)
subassemblies.description: Very top of the figure. Build 1 hair mass made from stacked/sloped pieces; aim for a rounded cap. Use 1 main top piece and 3 side/fringe pieces to suggest the layered swoop.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber (hilt + blue blade)
subassemblies.description: Right side accessory held in both hands. Build 1 hilt (cylindrical look) and 1 blade (a straight blue bar). Suggested segmentation: 1 pommel, 1 grip, 1 emitter, and 1 blade section.
subassemblies.imageRegion: Right side of image, angled upward from the hands to top-right corner.
